title: Employees will replace AI | Standup Comedy By Anmol Garg
description:
In this standup comedy video, Corporate Babaji Anmol Garg talks about how employees will replace AI. 
India mai nahin chalega Chatgpt aur Claude... 
AI is not going to take away your job...it's the other way around, because of AI people are getting jobs...

Comments mai batao sabse accha joke kaunsa laga and your opinion about AI!
